name: Cost and Reliability
tagline: Evaluate composite cost metrics across three active providers.
brief: Route payments using total expected cost across three online providers.
context: All 3 providers are online, but differ in fees and reliability. Failures incur ₦5 penalties.
narrative:
All three providers (A, B, C) are online, but they have different fee structures and reliability rates.

Provider A has the lowest base fee, but higher failure rates. Provider B offers the lowest overall expected cost when factoring in potential failure penalties.

Compare expected cost rather than raw base fee to keep total processing costs low.
objective: Process every payment and keep total cost at or below ₦3.00.
learningObjective: Optimize overall cost using composite metrics (expectedCost) rather than raw fee in isolation.
intelligenceExplanation:
The provider cards list calculated expected costs for A, B, and C. Provider B has the lowest expected cost.

Route through B: WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b.
hint: Select Provider B: WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b.
hints: Compare the expected cost (fee + failure risk) displayed on each provider card.

steps.label: Keep total cost at or below ₦3.00

functions.description: Send the payment through Provider A.
Send the payment through Provider B.
